# all inc.

> All Inc. builds software, user interfaces and connectivity for creatives: advanced instruments for the artificial intelligence. Its platform lets an artist perform an arena show from a single device, covering playback, showfiles, vocal processing and visuals.

## Products

- all act: Digital live performance system.
- all antiphon: Remote mixing and show control system.
- all link: Next generation wireless. Coming to CES 2028.

US & All Inc. is at 470 Ramona St., Palo Alto, California, United States.

## Pages

- [Home](https://allinc.fi/): all act, all antiphon and all link, and how to reach All Inc.
- [Privacy policy](https://allinc.fi/privacy/): how personal data is handled on the site and in the apps, EU/EEA and US rights, and how to request access or deletion

## Notes

- The website sets no cookies and runs no analytics or advertising trackers.
